jobs.title: Greeter at the entrance
jobs.why: Guests arrive all day and staff are often busy behind the counter. Greeting, waving and giving a short welcome needs only walking, gestures and speech, which K1 can do reliably.
jobs.limits: Cannot open doors, carry trays or handle payments. Keeps to a short scripted dialogue.

jobs.title: Menu and promo presenter
jobs.why: Staff repeat the daily specials and promotions to every guest. K1 can stand by the menu board, point at items and announce offers on a schedule.
jobs.limits: Cannot take orders or answer open-ended questions about allergens. Promo text must be set in advance.

jobs.title: Guiding guests to free tables
jobs.why: K1 can lead guests towards the seating area and point at a table. Staff spend several minutes per hour on this at peak times.
jobs.limits: Cannot see which tables are free without extra sensors or staff input. Narrow aisles and moving chairs make walking unreliable.

jobs.title: Dishwashing
jobs.why: Dishwashing takes a lot of staff time, but the work is wet, slippery and needs fine hand control.
jobs.limits: K1 cannot do wet manipulation: it is not waterproof and its hands cannot grip wet plates and glasses safely. Not feasible today.
